[[File:Skylane.png|thumb|right|250px|A skylane on Coruscant.]]

A '''skylane''' was a level of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] traffic that floated over such planets as the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. On Coruscant the skylanes were autonavigating.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|160|skylane}}</ref>
